findings.text: The company's accounts are not overdue, with the next accounts due 26 August 2027 and the last accounts made up to 28 February 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the next statement due 2 July 2027 and the last statement made up to 18 June 2026.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
Of the 9 charges registered, 2 are outstanding, 0 are part-satisfied and 7 are satisfied.
The company has 11 current officers, comprising 10 directors and 1 other officer.
No current person with significant control is on record, although this does not prove the company has no owner, as it may be exempt or have filed a PSC statement not covered by this check.

Across the 5 current directors checked, 83 other companies were found, of which 4 are converted closed, 25 dissolved, 1 in liquidation and 53 active; only the first 5 of 10 current directors were checked.
Since 24 October 2025, no registered office address changes were filed, and one director, PERSON 037, resigned on 6 May 2026.
